* If [[Revenge Of The Sith]] is on table and Dark loses 1 Force to make battle destiny modifiers affect total battle destiny instead, then the first Sith drawn for battle destiny will cause [[Revenge Of The Sith]] to add +2 to total battle destiny. The next Sith drawn for battle destiny will ''not'' cause [[Revenge Of The Sith]] to add another +2 (the cumulative rule prevents it).
